operatorIntent: No more tests. Build Episode 1 as a live franchise-quality production package, then move to storyboard art and Seedance reference-to-video.

agentAssignments.task: Approve Episode 1 story spine, pacing, and cliffhanger pressure.
Strengthen Marius, Selah, and Stillwater threat across scenes 6 and 10.
Generate clean storyboard frame prompts for @Image1 through @Image17.
Check every frame prompt against approved model sheets, props, face, hair, wardrobe, power rules, and no text/no grid constraints.
Use generated storyboard frames as ordered @Image references and submit the motion instructions from seedance-handoff.json.
Build narrator voice script, caption timing, thumbnail moment, and Remotion edit notes.
Final canon review before public render or paid media spend.

gates.name: Storyboard art gate
gates.requirement: All @Image storyboard frames must preserve character identity and avoid text/grid/reference-sheet layout.

gates.name: Seedance gate
gates.requirement: Only submit storyboard production frames, not raw model sheets.

gates.name: Live spend gate
gates.requirement: Use configured live providers only after Lore Guardian and Character Continuity QC pass.

nextCommandCenterAction: Open /command/video, run production mode or use these packet files as source for the storyboard/video builder.
